svg.title: Hotel availability: replay and local scaling

cc:Work.dc:title: Hotel availability: replay and local scaling
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 1. Synthetic, local Python hotel-availability reference. (a) Cumulative SQLite row counts in the loopback HTTP demo (2 hotels × 3 room types × 365 stay dates per snapshot). (b) Wall time for in-process source generation and collection/validation, initial SQLite write, and identical replay. Circles show five fresh-process runs per size; squares show medians, and bars show observed min-max ranges, not confidence intervals. Desktop load was not isolated. Live hotel API and BigQuery execution have not been validated or benchmarked.
